Headline: #56 Milwaukee Temporary Reroute at California/Milwaukee
ShortDescription: #56 Milwaukee buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near California/Milwaukee.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#56 Milwaukee buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Milwaukee, Armitage, California and Milwaukee, over normal route, due to street blockage near California/Milwaukee.

Allow extra travel time.
